units.name: Operations
units.evidence: Official faculty discipline page is titled Operations and identifies operations-science research in supply chains, transportation, matching markets, public health and policy. It is recorded as an academic area, not a formally named Operations Department.

decisions.reason: Official university directory establishes school parent; current Operations discipline replaces imported department/group wording without promoting area to department.

sources.note: University explicitly lists School of Management among its professional schools.
Full Yale School of Management name.
School mission and management graduate programs.
Operations faculty discipline directory and explicit OR/OM, supply-chain research.
Full Operations discipline heading, named faculty, operations science research including supply chains, transportation and matching markets.
Eight engineering departments inspected; no independent industrial-engineering department listed.
Broad applied computational mathematics scope, not treated as additional operations unit merely from algorithms.

limitations: Engineering department inventory checked; generic mathematical algorithms do not establish a separately named operations unit.
